english.title: M/vehicle driver fail give owner name / address / produce insurance / test cert - accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance or security under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See sections 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate
(iv) From 1st November 2019, the Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1047) removed the current securities regime, which was used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. A two-year transitional period applied to existing securities and deposits; this meant that new securities could not be issued, however, it did not prevent individuals renewing current securities - as long as they were valid until 1st November 2021. From 1st November 2021 compulsory motor insurance is required. See offence H100112.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). the defendant failed to give the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant insurance certificate and a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd modur yn methu rhoi enw/cyf y perchennog/cyflwyno tystysgrif prawf/yswiriant-trosedd/damwain ar y ffordd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan ofynnodd gwnstabl i chi wneud hynny, bu i chi fethu rhoi enw a chyfeiriad perchennog y cerbyd, a chyflwyno'r dystysgrif yswiriant neu sicrwydd berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio dan ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 a thystysgrif prawf a roddwyd yng nghyswllt y cerbyd.
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), methodd y diffynnydd i roi enw a chyfeiriad perchennog y cerbyd i gwnstabl yr heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, a methodd gyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol a thystysgrif prawf yng nghyswllt y cerbyd pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neud o fewn saith diwrnod wedi hynny.
